Name: Sarah Apple
Badge: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
Which version of the They Say / I Say routine (with visual texts or with annotation) feels like the best fit for your students right now? Why?:

Honestly, I could make either approach work right now in Biology but I will most likely start with annotation. I would primarily take this approach as we work with visuals quite regularly and I am trying to build in more opportunities for student reading.

Describe one way you might adapt the They Say / I Say framework to align with the types of texts your students read most often (e.g., articles, visuals, multimodal texts).:

I don't think I would need to adapt the framework but I would like to use the templates/sentence starters. I will adapt those by making the options much shorter and selecting those with language that is most accessible to where my students are currently.

What, if anything, do you need help thinking through as you plan for using They Say / I Say in your classroom?:

I am feeling inspired and ready to go!
